_comment: Mana abilities whose amount reads what their own cost named as it was paid. t_cost_bound_altar is the Illuminor Szeras shape (sacrifice another creature, add {B} equal to its mana value); t_cost_bound_stockpile is the Glittering Stockpile shape (sacrifice this artifact, add X of any one colour where X is the stash counters it had). t_cost_bound_mv3 and t_cost_bound_mv5 are the creatures fed to the altar.

cards.name: Test Cost Bound Altar
cards.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.

abilities.text: {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.

cards.name: Test Cost Bound Stockpile
cards.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of stash counters on this artifact.

abilities.text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of stash counters on this artifact.
